Name: NPC Minu English Translation
Author: Lambeeron
Description:
[center]Hello, Lamron here![/center]
[center]I haven't been able to test him out yet so there might be issues floating around.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6110/6110-1589961421-1908352968.png[/img]

I've added heart based festival dialogue for a more immersive experience.
I've tested them so they should be working!!

I've also added more likes and dislikes, he'll hint at them in his dialogue.

Males are referred to as Master, Females are referred to as Lady,
The dialogue doesn't change, just how you're adressed.

He'll cook various foods for you. f.e: Complete Breakfast, Red Plate, etc.

Bad news:
Unfortunately, I haven't translated the marriage dialogue yet. I've so far only fully translated the daily dialogue.

If you befriend him too fast, you'll miss out on some farmer-butler moments.

The dialogue can be very long, I advise to keep clicking Minu until you're sure there isn't anymore dialogue.

Love:
Diamond, Ruby
Emerald, Earth Crystal
Amethyst, Frozen Tear
Frozen Geode,
Magma Geode,
Ice cream, Blueberry Tart,
Blackberry Tart

Likes: 
Ghost Crystal,
Petrified Slime, Coffee,
Opal, Celestine, 
Omni Geode, Topaz,
Lemon Stone,
Sand Stone [/center]
